annotations.title: Read or request a QProof check

description: Read stored QProof evidence for an exact token with a canonical verdict and original evidence age. Unless request:false is supplied, unchecked or older-than-15-minute evidence requests the existing scheduled lane automatically; request:true explicitly asks that lane. Explicit request:false is cached-only: no queue, scan or paid work. Engine refresh windows and budgets still apply. A queue is reported only when confirmed; no completion ETA is promised. No inline scan, code execution or paid x402 scan.
name: qproof_check
